checklist.name: Both PRs have a title in conventional commit format
checklist.description: Each title follows `<type>(<ticket>): <imperative summary>` with a valid type and `PROJ-42` present

checklist.name: PR 1 title uses an appropriate type
checklist.description: PR 1 title type should be `chore` or `feat`, not `fix` or `test`

checklist.name: PR 2 title uses an appropriate type
checklist.description: PR 2 title type should be `feat`, not `chore` or `fix`

checklist.name: Both PRs have a What field
checklist.description: Each description contains a clearly labelled **What:** field

checklist.name: Both PRs have a Why field
checklist.description: Each description contains a clearly labelled **Why:** field

checklist.name: What field describes the diff in plain English
checklist.description: The What field summarises what changed in one sentence — not a file list and not a commit log message

checklist.name: Why field explains motivation or consequence
checklist.description: The Why field explains why this change was necessary or what would happen without it

checklist.name: PR 1 description references its role as prerequisite for PR 2
checklist.description: PR 1 description mentions that it provisions infrastructure the application logic in PR 2 depends on

checklist.name: Neither description lists files or commit hashes
checklist.description: Neither MR description contains raw file paths, commit SHAs, or a changelog-style list

checklist.name: What and Why fields are each one sentence
checklist.description: Each What field is a single sentence; each Why field is a single sentence

checklist.name: Descriptions are written for a reviewer with no prior context
checklist.description: A reviewer unfamiliar with the codebase could understand what changed and why
